changelog_html:
1.6.0

  • Reclaimed staff time is the headline at every volume, instead of switching between dollars and hours.
  • The staff cost field defaults to a BLS-sourced $21 an hour and cites its source on the page.
  • Cost per garnish is now the lead statistic; "cheaper per lb" is replaced by garnishes currently cut by hand each month.
  • Both cards show a time line, and the in-house card notes the 7 to 10 day conditioning step.
  • Fixes the grapefruit yield ratio, which implied negative waste against USDA water content.

1.5.0

  • Pricing follows the 2026 Bulk Rates sheet, replacing figures taken from the Faire export.
  • Bulk minimums apply to the whole order in any combination of fruit, rather than per fruit.
  • Adds the 60 lb and 360 lb price breaks and grapefruit whole as its own SKU.
